training.scope: Historical training plus initial profile 1201 attempts. Selection uses historical validation only. Exclude the distinct-mass vacuum family, nonplanar boxes, pentagons, and loops six and above. Profile 1237 remains fresh.

timing: Fresh process; full discovery or basis lookup, prediction, exact reduction, independent target check, recovery, and exit. Identical global deadline and per-call cap.

outside_scalar_formula.scope: Physical applicability of the existing exact scalar formula defines this subset; no timing threshold selects its requests.

deployment.reason: Retain neural preparation only if the matched interval is below one and every completed native request outside the exact-formula domain also completes with the neural model.
deployment.scope: Post-comparison deployment decision. The paper reports the frozen candidates separately; it does not claim an independent timing test of this selection rule.
